newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA shares rise ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: SIA shares rise ahead of results.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd foreign shares rose about five percent, or 60 cents, to Singapore $13.30 in active trading on Monday.
More than 1.8 million shares changed hands by noon, including a block of 472,000 shares crossed around S$12.78.
"The share price is very strong. But the local shares are flat," said a broker with a local firm.
The local shares hit a high of S$7.55 but eased back to S$7.50 with about 40,000 shares traded.
An analyst with a European research firm said there was no fundamental reason behind the rise except that the airline could release slightly better than expected results on Friday.
The market expects SIA's profit for the year ended March 31 1997 to be about S$1.04 billion, against previous year's S$1.03 billion.

"I don't think it would be much higher than market expectations. But there is programme buying of blue chips by some U.S. funds this morning and SIA is probably benefitting from this," said an analyst from a U.S. brokerage.
